decision: OD33 / PCD26.5 / 3xM2.5 remains the preferred compact J2 flange; the analytical screen does not justify returning to OD36/M3.
Pressure load is negligible relative to seal compression and bolt preload.
The tightest analytical margin is the conservative local flange-bending screen, not screw tensile capacity or pressure separation.
Do one local contact/stress FEA with 300 N/screw preload and the seal-force upper-bound before mechanical release.
release_holds: Local flange/contact FEA on final C2R1 geometry.
Exact screw grade/finish and anti-galling process.
Torque-preload production method; do not release a torque from a generic nut factor alone.
Exact supplier FKM compound compression-force confirmation / leak validation.
source_basis: Current MEDTAS Technical Filter: thread-strip screen >=3.10 at 300 N/screw and conservative local screen 135.6 MPa vs 170 MPa.
Current C2R1 geometry and controlled J2 seal geometry.
